name: Golden Gate Bridge
hint: Only two towers may stand in the strait. Drape a main cable between them and back to the banks, then hang the whole deck from it.

history.name: Golden Gate Bridge
history.engineer: Joseph Strauss (chief engineer), Charles Ellis, Leon Moisseiff, Irving Morrow (architect)
history.span: Main span 1,280 m · towers 227 m above the water
facts: Its colour, "International Orange", was chosen to suit the landscape and to keep the bridge visible in fog.
Each main cable is made of 27,572 individual wires.
A safety net under the deck saved 19 workers, who called themselves the "Halfway to Hell Club".
history.why: It held the record for the longest suspension span in the world from 1937 until 1964, across a deep, windy, foggy strait many said could not be bridged.
